title: Egress
offline: The Machine is offline. Egress can change once it is back.

missing.title: Agent not found
missing.body: The Machine may not have sent its Agents yet, or this Agent is gone

open.title: Reach the whole public internet
open.footer: For an Agent that does research: no Approval for each domain. Private networks stay closed (ADR 0029).
open.warning: Any page can try to trick the Agent into sending what is in its Workdir out. Use it only for an Agent that holds no tokens or important files.

domains.heading: Domains it may reach
domains.footer: Data can go out to any domain here, so add only ones you trust. *.example.com covers every subdomain. While working, the Agent can ask for a new domain with an Approval.
domains.emptyDetail: This Agent cannot reach the internet: every domain asks for an Approval
domains.emptyOpen: Not needed while the whole internet is open; used once the switch is off

invalid.title: Not a domain
invalid.body: Enter a domain alone, like github.com or *.npmjs.org, without https:// or a path

authenticate.open: Let {{name}} reach the whole public internet
authenticate.close: Let {{name}} reach only the domains in the list
